skill.summary: Generate customer-facing answers for common customer support questions. Use when working on FAQ content for support teams, customer success managers.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Build Customer Support FAQ Page skill.

- Generate customer-facing answers to common customer support questions.
- Designed for support teams and customer success managers creating FAQ content.
- Includes a workflow for clarifying requirements, drafting, enriching, and refining FAQs.
- Integrates with chat and web search APIs for data and research.
- Optimized for primary SEO keywords like "FAQ generator AI" and "customer support FAQ writer."
